readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine, before the watches were shown at dinner
When the husband made everyone show their watches, after the temple bell struck nine
The temple struck ten while Madame and the doctor were playing piquet in the salon
A moment after Dr Vauthier came back from fetching his cigars, the hall clock struck eleven

whereabouts: Aurèle Monnier was found in his atelier.
Madame Monnier dined at the usual hour.
Félix dined with the household that evening.
Aurèle Monnier made everyone show their watches around nine o'clock, at dinner.
There was a quarrel between Aurèle Monnier and Monsieur Girard at dinner.
After dinner, Madame Monnier and Dr Vauthier went into the salon.
Madame Monnier and Dr Vauthier played piquet in the salon without a break.
Dr Vauthier went out to fetch his cigars during the game.
Madame Monnier sat down at the piano and played while Dr Vauthier was out.
Dr Vauthier came back, and Madame Monnier stopped playing when he came in.
